ladder: Epicerie > Huiles et Vinaigres / Sel, Epices et Bouillons / Pates, Riz et Feculents / Conserves et Bocaux / Sauces et Condiments / Cuisine du Monde / Farines, Sucres et Patisserie > product kind (cooking oils; olive oil; short pasta; rice; mustard)

ladder: Pantry > Oils, vinegars and ghee / Grains and pastas / Canned and jarred / Spices, seasoning and salt / Baking basics / Honey and sweeteners / Nut butters and spreads
facets: organic; non-GMO; gluten-free; regenerative; fair-trade; no added sugars
quality_markers: certified organic first; non-GMO; gluten-free; regenerative; fair-trade; no preservatives or added sugars
quality_signals: USDA organic; Non-GMO Project Verified; regenerative organic certified
notes: Blog page showing nav and pantry groups; values-based filters lead, not type.

ladder: Refinement grade > processing > flavor > finishing vs cooking oil > origin > price > packaging > dates
quality_markers: less refined (extra-virgin); first cold-pressed; bitterness and pepper; harvest date; dark glass or tin
quality_signals: California Olive Oil Council seal; EU regulation; USDA
notes: Grade first, flavor second; origin said not to decide quality; harvest date ideal.

ladder: Designation (DOP or IGP) > ageing > label and ingredients
quality_markers: protected designation; ageing 60 days (IGP) vs 12 years (DOP) up to 25 years; no added caramel or thickener
quality_signals: Balsamic of Modena IGP; Traditional Balsamic of Modena DOP; extravecchio
notes: Designation and ageing decide quality; supermarket versions imitate colour with additives.

ladder: Variety (1121, 1509, Pusa, 370, Super Kernel) > grain length > broken percentage > moisture > age > chalky grains > colour and aroma
quality_markers: grain length; broken grains 0-2% premium; moisture 13% max; age; chalky grains under 3-5%
quality_signals: APEDA (India) minimum 6.61 mm basmati length
notes: Trade view: physical grade numbers decide; aged rice costs 10-20% more.

source_name: Olio2go (Virginia, US) olive oil and Italian pantry shop
ladder: Italian region north to south (Tuscany > Lazio > Sicily) > product (oil, vinegar, honey, pasta, farro, beans)
quality_markers: premium small-batch oil; cultivar and terroir; this year's oil to finish, last year's to cook
notes: Shelves run by region; manager rule: last year's oil to cook with, this year's to finish.

source_name: Great Taste Awards (Guild of Fine Food, UK)
ladder: Blind tasting by judges > 1 star > 2 stars > 3 stars
facets: product type entered (olive oil, nuts, salami, chocolate)
quality_markers: balance; texture; mouthfeel; aroma; finish; freshness; salt level
quality_signals: Great Taste 1, 2 and 3 stars; judged blind by 355 judges in 2021
notes: Product-level award across all food types; about 30 percent get one star, under 2 percent three.

source_name: Slow Food Ark of Taste (Slow Food Foundation, Italy)
ladder: Eligible food type > distinctive taste by local tradition > link to place and knowledge > small quantity > risk of loss
quality_markers: distinctive taste in local tradition; link to place; small quantity; at risk
quality_signals: Ark of Taste listing; Presidia projects
notes: Heritage-food movement that selects products, not producers; taste judged locally, not universally.

source_name: NYIOOC help centre (New York International Olive Oil Competition)
ladder: Judging and results; Awards and promotion (index only)

quality_markers: traceability to country, region, farm; hand-picked ripe cherries; washed natural honey; light to medium roast
quality_signals: SCA score 80+; Q-graders; under 5 defects per 350 g
notes: Menu leads with format (beans, capsules, sets) then specialty tier and decaf; specialty is its own shelf.

ladder: Shop by roast (light, medium, dark, espresso) > origin (Brazil, Colombia, Ethiopia, Kenya...) > processing method > single origin > flavor profile > award-winning
facets: roast; origin; process; flavor profile; best sellers; fresh arrivals
quality_markers: cup quality score; flavor profile; traceability; consistency; producer relations; processing
quality_signals: SCA 100-point scale by Q Graders: 90+ Outstanding, 85 Excellent, 80 Very Good; 86+ single origin
notes: Shop menus by roast and origin; score drives price; 'Award-Winning' is a shelf.

ladder: Espresso > Single Origin > Blends > Organic and Fair Trade > Geisha > Pearl Reserve > Decaf > Unroasted
facets: USDA Organic; Fair Trade; Rainforest Alliance (filter)
quality_markers: direct-trade sourcing; certifications as secondary labels
quality_signals: Fairtrade International; Rainforest Alliance; USDA Organic; Direct Trade (no standard)
notes: Leads with use (espresso) then single origin vs blend; separate rare-variety shelves (Geisha).

source_name: SCA grading and cupping (Colipse Coffee explainer)
ladder: Green defects (350 g) > bean screen size > roast sample > cupping score
quality_markers: zero Category 1 and max 5 Category 2 defects; bean size; cupping score
quality_signals: SCA cupping by Q Graders: 90-100 Outstanding, 85-89.99 Excellent, 80-84.99 Very Good, under 80 not specialty
notes: Defect inspection first, then cup score; page secondary to SCA own protocols.

source_name: Alliance for Coffee Excellence, Cup of Excellence rules
ladder: Pre-selection (86+) > national week > international week > round 5 (87+) > final top ten > online auction
quality_signals: Cup of Excellence (87+ in round 5); Presidential Award (over 90); National Winners; cupped blind, 100 points
notes: Competition by country; winning lots auctioned; set by ACE with in-country committees and an auditing firm.

ladder: Certification > issuer > meaning
quality_signals: Rainforest Alliance; Fairtrade/Max Havelaar; UTZ (merged 2019); Bird-Friendly (Smithsonian); Direct Trade; Organic
notes: Ethical-sourcing labels sit beside score; Direct Trade has no certifier.

ladder: Personal taste > tea type (green, white, yellow, oolong, black, dark by fermentation) > dry leaf, liquor, aroma, flavor, spent leaf > harvest season
facets: tea type; harvest season; sampler sets
quality_markers: dry leaf shape and colour; liquor clarity; aroma; no bitterness; spring over summer harvest
quality_signals: none defined; white tea grades named (Silver Needle, White Peony)
notes: Six Chinese categories lead; no formal grading; shop nav is Tea, Teaware, Tea Club.

ladder: Tea type (black, green, oolong, pu-erh, matcha, herbal) > plant part > processing > short ingredient list > pack size and storage
quality_markers: short ingredient list; pack and storage; origin alone not enough
quality_signals: none named
notes: German marketplace says country of origin does not predict taste; type and processing do.

ladder: Tea type by taste wanted (gyokuro and kabusecha sweet > sencha mild > matcha > hojicha and genmaicha) > production area
quality_markers: type for taste; area exactly 100 percent for regional name; avoid unclear origin
quality_signals: Japanese labelling rule: regional name needs 100 percent local leaf
notes: Japanese guide leads with processing type and shade-growing, then area; no grades.

ladder: Dutch-processed vs natural > brand > fat and pH data
quality_markers: alkalising; fine grind; fat and pH published by producer
quality_signals: organic (no body named); no grades
notes: Cocoa buyers choose process type by recipe; no recognised grade ladder found in this source.
